image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a wombat curled up inside a rocky burrow entrance. The animal's head is visible but tucked down, with the broad snout and rounded ears discernible despite the sleeping posture. The visible fur is coarse, thick, and greyish-brown. The body appears stocky and barrel-shaped, filling the dark cavity. Short forelimbs are partially visible tucked beneath the chest. The surrounding environment consists of rough, textured stones forming the burrow opening.
